title.narrative: Promoting active citizen engagement to fight against corruption in South Eastern Europe (ACE)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to enable rights holders and duty bearers in BiH, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro and Serbia to participate in the fight against corruption towards improving the quality of democratic governance in the Southeast Europe.More specifically, the project applies a two folded approach:•targeting civil society to enable them to pursue their rights and to reject corruption through Advocacy and Legal Advice Centres (ALACs) and •supporting advocacy actions oriented towards duty bearers to strengthen institutional frameworks that fight corruption.A new focus of this project is the output "Advocacy initiatives conducted for improved and enforeced national whistleblowing legislation,in line with the EU Directive on Whistleblower Prorection and best practice."Value of contract: EUR 642,230

recipient-region.narrative: The recipients are as follows:Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Serbia, North Macedonia, and Montenegro
